summary: Payette National Forest lookout site in Idaho County: L-4 cab by 1934, destroyed in 1978. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1978; no source describes what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Listed by Idaho Fire Lookouts as a hike-in site.

events.note: Tent camp, listed for the 1920s (decade only)
L-4 cab, with a patrol point about 3 miles north at 6,090 ft

evidence.supports: 1934 L-4 cab with patrol lookout 3 mi north at 6,090 ft
evidence.quote: 1934: L-4 Cab with Patrol Lookout 3mi North @ 6090′

evidence.supports: 1934 L-4 cab; patrol point 3 miles north at 6,090 ft; destroyed 1978
evidence.quote: 1934: L-4 cab. Patrol point 3 miles north at 6090'. Destroyed 1978.

evidence.supports: in Idaho County, 12 miles east of Chamberlain Guard Station
separate Grass Mountain lookout in Kaniksu National Forest, destroyed 1955

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 L-4 cab and the 1978 destruction; none describes the site today or its access. Record location (45.15442, -116.20202) was not confirmed: the Forest Lookouts index gives the township as T24N R12E Sec 26 and firelookout.com says 12 miles east of Chamberlain G.S., and by rough arithmetic on the township the point looks about a degree of longitude farther east. Please check the point; I did not propose a coordinate because no source gives one. Do not confuse with the Kaniksu National Forest Grass Mountain lookout on idahofirelookouts.com (northern-idaho/grass-mountain-lookout-2), destroyed 1955, which is a different site. Access level left unset: no source states it.
